scope: One existing candidate: exact NDC article/exposure and donor/timing audit, clinical comparator update, patent/program/capture provenance and claim-specific marginal-dollar decision.

selection.objective: Expected value of the next marginal information/development dollar, with remaining clinical risk, cost, time and capturable value
selection.selected_uncertainty: Whether the exact NDC9009 topical article can support a useful claim at tolerable epidermal exposure with an incremental product contribution and plausible retained value
selection.basis: Next eligible bounded source sprint after APR, RM and BLU closure; prior independent conditional order challenged with exact article, comparator and patent/program evidence

delta: Complete selected NDC source sprint; retain APR1/RM2/BLU3/NDC4 conditional development order, original-scope dependence and no automatic financial allocation.
Specific later C18 disclosure and paper attribution strengthen provenance without establishing a fully mapped patent claim, current title, license, batch or clinical product.
Sponsor public Darier overlap makes retained contribution explicit; do not infer NDC aliases to NRDN201/301 or molecule abandonment.
Add previously omitted SGT210 controlled Darier non-differentiation and indication stop; distinguish result date from discovery date, unknown final denominators, and a different drug from NDC.
Separate exact roflumilast cream case, co-treated sequential poster and sparse oral conference summary; preserve dantrolene 16/10/6 and inaccessible October source limits.
Amend the broad prevention-only stop to a claim-specific rule. Assembly establishes neither lesion repair nor clinical prevention; useful control need not be permanent cure.
Retain historical $40–150k/3–6 month useful-function assumption as unpriced and scope-dependent. Qualification-only work needs a new comparison even if the price is unchanged.
Close this finite public-source pass pending a substantive article/function/exposure/comparator/rights/access/cost fact that changes a named commitment.

reopen_for: Exact-NDC delayed or clinically useful preventive/control function
Measured dissolved or viable-epidermis exposure and local tolerance
Relevant controlled comparator outcome with usable denominators
Substantive newly accessible missing primary evidence
Exact rights/supply/access/cost fact changing an executable contribution

activity_boundary: Published-document research, deterministic content checks and repository publication only. No outreach, purchases, recruitment, experiments, simulations or material receipt.
interpretation_limits: No new exact-NDC human outcome or qualified topical exposure window.
Named C18 disclosure is not a complete claim/image mapping, legal-status finding or license.
SGT210 sponsor result gives no verified final denominator/effect estimate and cannot be transferred to NDC.
Additional PDE4 observations are sparse and co-treated or oral, not pooled cream monotherapy evidence.
Known dantrolene result denominators retained; missing October full-text methods remain unknown.
Prevention/control are distinct unevidenced product hypotheses, not automatic substitutes for a failed repair claim.
Actual costs, information yield, access, rights and retained economic value remain unvalidated.
